reason: 该插件的主导向为界面背景与主题布局增强：将本机 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸库接入 DSH Web GUI 并提供壁纸设计面板进行显示参数调节，且同时带有用于扫描/查询/设置壁纸的 Agent 工具入口，故分类以 themes-layout 为主，并标注具有本地文件、媒体渲染与界面控制能力。

summaries.zh: 该插件可让 DSH Web GUI 使用本机 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸作为页面背景，并提供侧边栏“壁纸设计”面板进行透明度、模糊、范围、帧率等效果的实时调整。
summaries.en: This plugin lets the DSH Web GUI use local Wallpaper Engine assets as the page background and offers a side panel to adjust visual settings like opacity, blur, scope, and FPS effects in real time.

capabilities: Scans local Wallpaper Engine project locations and related metadata for available wallpapers
Renders image, video, and web wallpapers as DSH Web GUI page backgrounds with adjustable visual effects
Provides agent tools to scan, list, and set wallpaper configuration values

reasons.code: README states the plugin scans Steam Workshop 431960 plus local projects, parsing project.json or file extensions to build a wallpaper library.
README describes rendering image/video/web wallpapers and a dedicated side-panel UI for real-time effects such as opacity, blur, vignette, scope, and carousel.
README lists Agent tools wallpaper_scan, wallpaper_list, wallpaper_set, wallpaper_config for querying and applying wallpaper selections.
package.json declares this as a DSH web platform plugin with web client injection and exposes module entry points for runtime integration.
